exit: taker at executable BBO, including target; no resting take-profit
unknown: CENSORED and EXCLUDED have no class target and are never zero PnL
policy: choose side of maximum expected net; threshold 0; stop evaluation at first selected censored outcome
values: per-class mean observed net estimated on fitting months only; no conditional net regression
admission: A2 net daily bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0 and at least 30 filled trades; otherwise operational WAIT
scene_selection: first supported calendar evaluation scenes plus first TAKE, STOP, TIME, EMPTY and CENSORED episode candidates; no best-PnL selection
claims: seconds-level flow response only; not order-ID behavior, real broker fills, futures margin, market impact or blind profitability
